nom: COOLA Classic Face Organic Sunscreen Lotion SPF 30 - Cucumber

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin are split: several call it their holy grail because it doesn't clog pores or cause breakouts and controls shine well, while others with oily skin find it leaves a dewy shine or feels a bit heavy and recommend setting it with powder.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, and several others recommending it specifically for normal-to-dry skin, report it feels soothing, soft, and more like a hydrating moisturizer than a typical sunscreen.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report the formula blends in well and works better for them than mineral alternatives they've tried, with no pilling or issues layering under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin consistently report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts, including one whose skin normally reacts to certain chemical UV filters not used in this formula.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, describe the formula as hydrating and more like a moisturizer than a typical sunscreen; one reviewer, however, warns it isn't very hydrating on its own and suggests applying a moisturizer underneath if your skin is dry.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report the formula does not leave skin red or irritated, including one esthetician who normally reacts to certain chemical UV filters but tolerates this formula well since it omits those specific ingredients.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin, including some managing hormonal acne, consistently report the formula is non-comedogenic in practice — it does not clog pores or trigger breakouts, and several call it the only sunscreen that hasn't broken them out.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers managing oiliness, especially around the T-zone, are divided: some find it noncomedogenic and shine-controlling enough to wear alone, while others find it adds a dewy sheen or slight greasiness by midday and recommend setting it with powder.

aspects.libelle: No white cast on any skin tone
Light cucumber scent that fades quickly
Layers well under makeup without pilling
Marketed organic but uses synthetic chemical UV filters
Needs reapplying roughly every 40 minutes in real sun

extraits.texte: I bought this because I needed reef barrier sunscreen. I initially loved it- how it went on, the scent, 70% organic. I followed the directions and ended up with 2nd degree burns on the top of my entire nose. I have already had two layers of skin come off and the third is about to. The doctor said you need the chemicals in the lotion, to prevent burns. And that with organic it should be applied more often. If it says reapply after 30 minutes. It should be applied after 15. I hope I don't end up with scarring. This is not a good product for the Caribbean. I burned in other places too but not as bad because I was walking around andnot laying in the sun. Thank God! I would have been burnt over my entire body with 2nd degree burns. Use with caution. The after lotion did nothing but is fine as a daily moisturizer- if you want to spend that kind of money.- hopefully they will use this review to improve their product and hoping they will refund my money- I was so excited about this product and now disappointed and temporarily disfigured -

I used Coola cucumber face sunscreen previously and liked it for its lightweight texture and matte finish. Loved how my skin looked day to day and also how my skin felt. Needed to replace my tube as I've been using daily sunscreen and thought I should get another tube so bought this thinking it would be the same. But it's not. It is greasy and mak s my skin look awful on my Zoom meetings. I realize they changed the formula and i wont be buying Coola again.

I like that this absorbs easily and protects against the sun. The packaging is a fun bright color ideal for spring and summer and it's a sleek size that's easy to slip into my bag. It absorbed rather quickly which was nice compared to products that just sit on your skin. The consistency is thin and spreadable and doesn't have the weird oil that comes out before the actual sunscreen comes out. It gave me a bit more of a dewy complexion when I prefer matte due to my oily skin. I put this on before using a powder mineral foundation and that helped but it did feel a little heavy on my skin. It has a light cucumber scent that's refreshing when you're getting ready to be out in the sun. I'd recommend this more to someone with normal to dry skin rather than oily. I absolutely love this sunscreen, it's very lightweight, moisturizing and fluffy! It blends into the skin so easy and leaves no white cast! I love that it's small enough to take on the go and it's the perfect size for my purse, I love having my sunscreen with me to reapply through out the day! It has a nice light and fresh cucumber scent that goes away quickly if you don't like scents. It's great that it doesn't leave you greasy and my makeup blends in without any issue! I have really sensitive skin and this does not break me out or leave my face red. The price is great, I'm a huge fan of Coola! It comes in a tube which I love because you're able to get all the product out easy and there's no chance that any is left behind. This is definitely a new staple in my collection. I really enjoy this sunscreen! I was surprised by the cucumber scent because I didn't think it would smell EXACTLY like it. So if you hate cucumber then I would try another scent. I have my eyes on the coconut scent for summer! The texture is smooth and creamy and my makeup had no issues with staying power. In the picture I applied some to the back of my wrist so you can see the product after drying, it's basically invisible with a tiny bit of dew when the sun reflects. If you have dry skin like me then I think you will find this soothing, but I can't give advice if you're oily. With all that said I definitely recommend.
